instruction: Candid documentary photograph, wide shot, high angle. In an indoor studio with white walls and a red carpet, the man in the black polo shirt and blue shorts (R1) stands on the left, facing right and extending his right arm to touch the woman in the white patterned t-shirt and blue jeans (R2). The woman stands on the right, facing away from the camera towards the man. The setting features hanging cables, a radiator on the left, and a wooden floor border under overhead fluorescent lighting, casting soft shadows on the red carpet.
elements: R1 actively extends his right arm to touch R2
R2 is the recipient of R1's touch rather than the initiator
R1 faces toward R2 while making the arm contact
R2 stands oriented toward R1 as he reaches to touch her
the interaction occurs on a red carpet in an indoor studio
